outcome: Recovered canonical parser and action-dispatch grammar. emails/send is an explicit unhandled false branch, not an existing-draft send interface. New-mail body/signature and event location are parsed and forwarded; their visible New Outlook effects remain unverified here.

subject.offset_contract: All evidence ranges below lie in __TEXT, whose vmaddr is 0x100000000 and fileoff is 0. file_offset is into the ORIGINAL universal binary, including the arm64 slice offset. vm_start is unslid. Prior survey offsets often concern x86_64 and are not interchangeable.

scope.performed: Read-only static analysis of installed app-bundle binaries and Info.plist. Extracted a separate arm64 copy under /tmp. Read local Apple SDK formatter headers. No Outlook execution.
scope.not_performed: No launch, URL opening, Apple events, Outlook data/preferences or HxStore access, mailbox reads, credential/token/key/keychain/DB-dump/.env reads, decryption, Microsoft 365/Graph/SMTP/EWS, production writes, or merge.

classification_procedure: Does an enum raw-value getter reconstruct a spelling? Yes: classify as a recognized key, not a visible field effect.
Does the selected action branch actually read that key? Yes: classify as parsed. Follow its conversion and downstream call arguments.
Does the action branch directly return false? Yes for emails/send: classify as unhandled in this canonical dispatcher. Do not infer capabilities from the send enum name.
Was Outlook run this session? No: call all visible UI and delivery behavior untested. Supplied probes remain attributed observations.
Does a negative cover the whole app? No: bound it to the named getter, dispatcher, and traced callees.

glossary.wire_key: The query name reconstructed by the enum or consumed by the handler. A reflection field label alone does not qualify.
glossary.parsed: The selected action reads the query item and converts it. Parsed location is not proof of a filled Location control.
glossary.forwarded: The value reaches the named action-handler argument. A downstream implementation can still ignore it.
glossary.unhandled: The selected branch returns false before an action call. This differs from a missing string or a failed live send.

common_query_grammar.lookup: Foundation URLComponents(url:resolvingAgainstBaseURL:false).queryItems; localized case-insensitive key comparison; first matching item wins; absent or empty scalar becomes nil. Repeated keys are not accumulated.
common_query_grammar.encoding: Use percent-encoded URL query values. The handler consumes URLQueryItem.value, then bridges ordinary Swift strings to NSString. No base64 or JSON body/attachment envelope appears in the traced path. Foundation percent decoding is delegated to the system, not reimplemented or runtime-tested here.
common_query_grammar.arrays: Split the first matching decoded value on either comma or semicolon, remove empty components, preserve whitespace. Encode each path before building the URL, but percent-encoding a comma/semicolon inside a filename does not escape it from the later split.

body.value: Ordinary query text, forwarded as NSString to body:. No special body codec in canonical parsing.
body.visible_effect: Supplied live probe said ignored. Static trace confirms parsing and forwarding, not rendering. A different spelling is not supported by this evidence.

signature.value: String forwarded to signatureName:, indicating a signature name rather than a Boolean or signature body. Matching/fallback semantics of the installed UI implementation remain unproven.

account.value: Signed decimal Int converted to NSNumber, then matched against account hash in sharedCollectionWithoutLDAPWithoutOMC.accounts. accountID is not the canonical query key. Omitted, invalid or unresolvable account yields nil; downstream receives nil for normal default-account handling. No account IDs were read.

attachments.value: One decoded query value containing filesystem path strings separated by comma or semicolon. Each existing path becomes a file URL via URL(fileURLWithPath:). Supply a path such as /tmp/example.txt, not file:///tmp/example.txt. Absolute paths are the reproducible intended form; code does not explicitly require absolute paths.
attachments.missing_path: Shows fileNotFound transient info, skips that item, continues with other items. Does not abort all composition.
attachments.caveats: Existence checks do not prove sandbox readability or successful UI attachment. No files were attached or opened.

send.requires: No set of query values reaches a send implementation on this branch. Adding immutableID/account cannot change the direct false return.
send.does: No draft lookup, compose, send or confirmation call occurs on this branch. This is a static control-flow conclusion, not a send test.

existing_message.requires: Resolvable decimal account and nonempty immutableID. The handler reverses Exchange web-safe characters before message lookup.
existing_message.distinction: Existing-message open is the branch using IDs; send never enters it. A source literal in the prior survey uses emails/message/open, but this handler tests open first and message second. No existing message was opened.

emails.from: Recognized enum key; the traced new branch does not read it.

location.visible_effect: Supplied live probe said ignored. Canonical handler reads and forwards it; this report does not claim the New Outlook UI honors it.

attendees.value: Same comma-or-semicolon split as mail recipient and attachment arrays. First query item only, empty parts removed, whitespace preserved. Values go to attendees: as NSArray of strings.

isallday.false: Every other nonempty value, including true, 1, yes and f.
isallday.omitted_or_empty: Optional.none. The handler infers all-day from date parse results instead of forcing false.

description.result: No body or description case in the complete 15-case query enum, and the new handler passes nil to description:. No alternate description query key is supported by this traced path.

dates.parser: Date.parseUsingIS8601DateFormatter(from:). Three ordered attempts below. These are formatter configurations, not a claim that Foundation strictly rejects every other input spelling.

attempts.timezone: Explicit RFC 3339 Z or offset. Default NSISO8601DateFormatter options; default GMT.
New formatter default GMT; this third formatter does not receive current time zone.

dates.fractional_seconds: No attempt sets withFractionalSeconds, 0x800. Extra Foundation permissiveness, trailing characters and fractional inputs were not exercised.
dates.failure: If all formatter attempts fail, returns nil. No Outlook or Foundation date execution tests were run.

origin.finding: No origin allowlist precondition in the examined canonical dispatchers and mail/event action branches. Events logURLAction reads origin and widget attributes for telemetry. Omitted origin is supported by that accessor. Unknown or malformed widget attributes can invoke diagnostics; do not treat arbitrary origin values as a supported authorization bypass.
origin.scope: CanonicalOutlookURL origin decoder, Emails/Events canHandleURL, processURLAsCanonicalURLResult, mail route handler, event-new route and event telemetry. Universal-link handler and outer application URL reception are outside this negative.

app_focus.finding: No NSApplication.isActive/frontmost-app prerequisite found in these traced dispatch/action paths. MainActor hops marshal UI work; they do not test whether Outlook is frontmost. Accounts and installed message/calendar action handlers must resolve.
app_focus.scope: Bounded static negative. Does not establish behavior while Outlook is closed, locked, modal, signing in, under a focus profile, or under an outer launch-services handler.

prior_evidence.role: Starting vocabulary, not control-flow proof. Recovered enum/function evidence here supersedes the send-by-IDs hypothesis for this canonical branch.
prior_evidence.supplied_observations: Orchestrator reported editable events/new with title/start/end honored and location ignored; editable emails/new with to/subject honored and body/attachments ignored; emails/send did nothing. Not repeated.

decisions.decision: Follow arm64 raw-value getters, query conversion and action branches, with original-file offsets and byte hashes. Do not promote reflection strings to handler behavior.
decisions.tradeoff: Only arm64 control flow is claimed; x86_64 parity is not inferred.

decisions.frontier: Can send-by-IDs be presumed or probed?
decisions.decision: No probe. Report the direct false branch and keep existing-message IDs under open/message.
decisions.tradeoff: No live mail delivery claim; no mailbox identifiers needed.

decisions.frontier: Should ignored fields be renamed or considered unsupported?
decisions.decision: Keep exact recovered spellings and label parsed/forwarded separately from visible effects.
decisions.tradeoff: The downstream reason body/location were ignored remains unresolved by this slice.

decisions.frontier: Should a parser emulator or integration be added?
decisions.decision: No. Installed disassemblers and bounded byte reads suffice. Add only the requested JSON artifact. No parser helper was authored, so parser TDD is not applicable.
decisions.tradeoff: No runtime contract test, synthetic implementation or maintained scanner. Verification checks actual binary ranges.

decisions.frontier: How broad can negative origin/focus claims be?
decisions.decision: Bound them to canonical dispatch and traced mail/event handlers. Treat MainActor scheduling as scheduling.
decisions.tradeoff: Outer application reception, runtime registrations and dynamic UI gating remain unproven.

decisions.frontier: How are dates specified without executing Outlook?
decisions.decision: Record exact formatter attempts and local SDK flag definitions; distinguish configuration from exhaustive accepted-language testing.
decisions.tradeoff: Foundation leniency and edge formats are untested.

decisions.decision: Commit/push this standalone checkout, open a PR against main, and do not merge as explicitly assigned.
decisions.tradeoff: Retain checkout and PR for orchestrator review. No CARR production record mutation.

Paths ordinal 0=open, 1=new, 2=send, 3=message, 4=conversation.
Lowercases first path component. send ordinal 2 branches to 0x102d18138. new ordinal 1 enters newMessage. open/message enters openMessage.
Returns false immediately; no query read, existing-draft lookup, compose or confirmation call on this branch.
Reads to,cc,bcc,subject,body,signature,attachments, then optional account lookup.
Each split string goes to NSFileManager.fileExistsAtPath:. Existing paths become URL(fileURLWithPath:). Missing paths show fileNotFound and are skipped.
